propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml performs duplicate test coverage already run in the _build-and-test.yml matrix, consuming one of 21 concurrent job slots against a 20-slot org-wide cap.
Deletion of import-linter is safe because its two test files carry no pytest markers and are already collected by all matrix cells (3.11/3.12/3.13 + macOS).
Without a durable collection guard, a future contributor adding markers or moving files could inadvertently drop these tests from the default suite with a passing build.
A checked-in test must assert that tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py collect exactly 9 items under the default selection (-m "not integration and not external").
The collection guard must fail if any marker (file-level pytestmark, decorator, or conftest-applied) excludes either file from the default selection.
